newsitem.title: USA: Coors says lower beer volume offset by high prices.
newsitem.headline: Coors says lower beer volume offset by high prices.

text.p: Adolph Coors Co, reporting higher third quarter earnings despite lower sales, said increased prices received for its products largely offset lower unit volume that led to the sales decline.
It said unit volume of beer and other malt beverages totaled 5.357 million barrels in the quarter, down 3.3 percent from 5.540 million barrels in the restated year-earlier period.
Coors said Molson Breweries of Canada will continue to brew and market Coors products in Canada for an interim period ending on or after June 30, 1997.

"From Oct 18, 1996, through June 30, 1997, assuming recent sales volume trends continue, Coors estimates that it will receive at least an additional $10 million of pretax international income from Molson," Coors said.
